<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター・レベル６中央シャフト通路</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、デス・スター内でルークとオビ＝ワンの戦闘力が＋２される。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、敵側はデス・スターの各位置カードを支配するのに能力値２を必要とする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Death-Star-Level-6-Core-Shaft-Corridor-SWCA-97586.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor.

'''Light Side:''' If you control, Luke and Obi-Wan are power +2 on the Death Star.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control, the opponent needs ability 2 to control each Death Star site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
